title: Robot arm
what: An assembly with joints you can drive.
hint: In the full app, open Assemble > Drive Joints and turn the base, swing the shoulder, or bend the elbow.

title: RailCore II 300ZL
what: A complete 3D printer: frame, motion system, and electronics enclosure, with every part where its designers placed it.
stats: 379 of 379 parts placed · 153 of 416 features editable · 19 parts fully editable

credit.author: RailCore® II 300ZL by J. Steve White and Tony Akens

notice: Converted from the original Fusion design to SolidCraft by Dutchman Convert; the design itself is unchanged.
hint: In the full app, step through the History bar: 153 features came through editable, with their sketches. The rest of each part is an imported solid.

title: Voron 2.4r2
what: A complete 3D printer assembly of 1,683 parts, each body in the colour it has in the original.
stats: 1,683 of 1,683 parts placed · every body in its own colour
notice: Not affiliated with Voron Design. The converted file is a derivative of the Voron 2.4r2 CAD, licensed GPL-3.0; its source is the Voron 2.4r2 assembly in the linked repository.
hint: Too large for the browser viewer. The download for SolidCraft on your computer is coming soon.

title: A part with its feature history
what: A sketch with its dimensions and constraints, a pad, and a fillet, with verified editable history.
hint: In the full app, double-click the extrude in the History bar, change its length, and the part rebuilds. Geometry was verified against the source.

title: Counterbored block
what: Two sketches, a pad, and a counterbored hole, with verified editable history.
hint: In the full app, inspect Pad and Hole in the History bar. Geometry was verified against the source.

title: Raised pad
what: Two sketches and two additive extrudes, with verified editable history.
hint: In the full app, inspect Pad and EmbossPad in the History bar. Geometry was verified against the source; four parameters were renamed because their names repeat.
